intro.title: Implement TupleToUnion type
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a TypeScript utility type called TupleToUnion that converts a tuple type into a union type. You will learn how to use indexed access types to extract all possible element types from a tuple. The core concept involves understanding how TypeScript's type system can manipulate tuple structures to produce unions. You will work with generic type parameters and the indexed access syntax T[number]. This exercise will strengthen your ability to create reusable type transformations in TypeScript.
intro.usecase: The TupleToUnion type is essential in TypeScript for transforming fixed arrays of values into reusable union types. This pattern appears in real-world UI components like form validation, where a list of allowed input states (e.g., ['pending', 'approved', 'rejected']) can be converted into a union type for strict type-checking. It's also used in dashboard filters or menu configurations, where predefined options from a tuple ensure type safety across selectors, modals, and data panels, preventing runtime errors and improving developer productivity.
